mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common type of pollution and would continue to be a problem in England, especially later during the industrial revolution, and extending into the recent past with the Great Smog of 1952."

Air pollution is the most common type of pollution and would continue to be a problem in England, especially later during the industrial revolution, and extending into the recent past with the Great Smog of 1952.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most frequently referenced forms of oil-related pollution in the Niger Delta, there are in fact several other ways in which the oil industry is harming the environment."

Oil spills and gas flaring are the most frequently referenced forms of oil-related pollution in the Niger Delta, there are in fact several other ways in which the oil industry is harming the environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a prominent signatory to a number of these multilateral treaties on environmental protection."
Nigeria is a prominent signatory to a number of these multilateral treaties on environmental protection.

Toxic is defined in the Basel Convention as having poisonous effects if breathed in, eaten or absorbed by the skin, including carcinogenicity i.e. cancer - producing.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a civil wrong, which entitles the injured party to claims and damages for his or her loss or seek an injunction for the discontinuance or prevention of the wrong."
A tort is a civil wrong, which entitles the injured party to claims and damages for his or her loss or seek an injunction for the discontinuance or prevention of the wrong.

Noise is a sound, especially when it is loud, unpleasant or disturbing.

Incineration is a disposal method in which solid organic wastes are subjected to combustion so as to convert them into residue and gaseous products.

Water pollution is the process of altering the properties of any water which renders it unfit for consumption.
